newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sappi buys outstanding 3 pct of SD Warren.
newsitem.headline: Sappi buys outstanding 3 pct of SD Warren.

text.p: South African paper products group Sappi Ltd said on Thursday it had entered into an agreement with U.S.-based SDW Holdings Corp to buy the outstanding three percent in subsidiary SD Warren that it does not yet own.
The purchase, which is expected to become unconditional around September 5, would be made at $17.60 a share.
Sappi in May bought the minority equity holdings in SDW from a consortium of investors giving it 97 percent of paper firm Warren on a fully diluted basis.
Sappi said there was no assurance that all conditions to the merger will be satisfied.
